ValidationRule.description: Validate amounts and delivery details while allowing an untouched pending checkout draft.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: OR( Grand_Total__c < 0, Discount_Amount__c < 0, Shipping_Charges__c < 0, AND( ISPICKVAL(Order_Status__c, "Confirmed"), ISBLANK(Shipping_Address__c) ), AND( OR( ISPICKVAL(Order_Status__c, "Confirmed"), NOT(ISBLANK(Shipping_Address__c)), NOT(ISBLANK(Shipping_City__c)), NOT(ISBLANK(Shipping_State__c)), NOT(ISBLANK(Shipping_Postal_Code__c)) ), OR( ISBLANK(Shipping_City__c), ISBLANK(Shipping_State__c), ISBLANK(Shipping_Postal_Code__c) ) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Order amounts cannot be negative. Enter complete delivery details when adding an address or confirming an order.
